items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Kid Howard used to try to imitate Buddy... Howard is more closer to Chris than anyone of them... Chris taught him a whole lot

ctx.x: Can you, did, did he play anything like anybody you could mention, to give an idea of comparing him with anybody or anything?
No, there's nobody around who ever played like Buddy. Kid Howard used to try to imitate Buddy, but I mean, no. He never could. No.
Did he play anything like Bunk? Well, a little bit.
